bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = true
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
printf 'GAYBBS_BUNDLE_SHA='
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1
printf 'GATEAPP_CHECKOUT_SHA='
git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'USERBOT_ACTIVE='
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service
printf 'USERBOT_ENABLED='
systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service
printf 'GSERVER_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT=PASS\n'
